To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the AK gap and the anode mesh material are the most critical parameters in an axial vircators design.
the AK gap is the most important parameter in the design of a vircator.

(i) the output HPM frequency is inversely proportional to the AK gap, (ii) the output HMP power is directly proportional to the IREB current, (iii) the IREB space charge limited current is proportional to the IBE voltage, (iv) copper is the most suitable material for anode mesh, and (v) Child-Langmuirs law holds for an axial vircators.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development and optimization of an axial virecator.
the design, simulation, and analysis of an IREB based axial vircator for HPM applications.
the simulation and analysis of an axially symmetric vircator using the PIC code, Magic.
